title: 日本ダービーの後に・星あげます！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto wins the Japanese Derby, surpassing Admire Vega. But unlike her competitor, there is no one to whom she can dedicate this star of victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Admire Vega respectfully takes her leave. As Meisho Doto watches, she dreams of one day finding someone to run for.
